atoms.exact_source_text: Provisioning keeps prepared things ready.
atoms.normalized_claim: Provisioning keeps prepared things ready.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Project Queue makes lasting things real.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Project Queue makes lasting things real.

atoms.exact_source_text: Adopted.
atoms.normalized_claim: BSA-10 Cross-Functional Supply Classes is adopted.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supplies use a small set of physical-function classes.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies use a small set of physical-function classes.

atoms.exact_source_text: They do not map one-to-one onto the five MEET Turn verbs.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies do not map one-to-one onto the five MEET Turn verbs.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Supply class has a concrete physical logic, broad utility, a fixed simple recipe, and species- or circumstance-specific manifestations.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Supply class has a concrete physical logic, broad utility, a fixed simple recipe, and species- or circumstance-specific manifestations.

atoms.exact_source_text: The class remains stable while the represented object varies.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Supply class remains stable while the represented object varies.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Binding** | Tie, secure, tether, wrap, patch, restrain | 2 Flexible Scrap |
atoms.normalized_claim: Binding supply class functions include tie, secure, tether, wrap, patch, restrain and requires 2 Flexible Scrap.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Remedy** | Soothe, stabilize, clean, revive, protect | 1 Sustenance + 1 Flexible Scrap |
atoms.normalized_claim: Remedy supply class functions include soothe, stabilize, clean, revive, protect and requires 1 Sustenance plus 1 Flexible Scrap.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Distraction** | Lure, occupy, misdirect, bait, mask | 2 Sustenance |
atoms.normalized_claim: Distraction supply class functions include lure, occupy, misdirect, bait, mask and requires 2 Sustenance.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Device** | Wedge, mark, signal, brace, trigger, probe | 1 Flexible Scrap + 1 Rigid Scrap |
atoms.normalized_claim: Device supply class functions include wedge, mark, signal, brace, trigger, probe and requires 1 Flexible Scrap plus 1 Rigid Scrap.

atoms.exact_source_text: The names and exact recipes remain subject to the dedicated Supply pass.
atoms.normalized_claim: The names and exact recipes remain subject to the dedicated Supply pass.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supplies describe prepared things and what those things can do—not prepaid copies of Turn verbs.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies describe prepared things and what those things can do—not prepaid copies of Turn verbs.

atoms.exact_source_text: Adopted.
atoms.normalized_claim: BSA-10A General Utility Doctrine for Supplies is adopted.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Supply class represents a broad physical capability, not an encounter key and not a consumable copy of one MEET Turn.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply class represents a broad physical capability, not an encounter key and not a consumable copy of one MEET Turn.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Supply should be potentially useful in many circumstances.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Supply should be potentially useful in many circumstances.

atoms.exact_source_text: Its physical verbs may support different Turns depending on context.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply's physical verbs may support different Turns depending on context.
